svg.title: Tradely owl brand series
svg.text: One owl. Six ways to guide the next step.
Flat vector assets · shared anatomy · purposeful expressions
Yellow body, brown wings, ivory eye discs, feather tufts and a short beak. Every time.
Pair the character with a clear message and an action. Expressions never replace feedback.

g.text: One clear question is enough to begin.
A blank page. A fresh question.
Choose a lesson to start your research notes.
Review what you learned, then keep going.

svg.text: Use the canonical flat logo for navigation.
Keep the character still during focused tasks.
Keep the palette and silhouette. No gradients, drop shadows or invented success states.
Use the completion pose only after a confirmed event. Keep next-step copy separate and editable.
